context: Tests: framework loading and fallback, session filter parsing, reading git context, heading adaptation and the Sessions Reviewed list.

checklist.name: Framework lookup attempted
checklist.description: The agent checks for domain-finance.md at the configured domain frameworks location

checklist.name: Missing file warned
checklist.description: The agent tells the user that the finance framework file is missing

checklist.name: Falls back instead of aborting
checklist.description: The agent continues with the generic framework and does not stop

checklist.name: Session loader run
checklist.description: The agent runs the session filter script with the 7-day argument

checklist.name: PERIOD parsed separately
checklist.description: The agent takes the PERIOD value from the first line and treats only the remaining 4 lines as session paths

checklist.name: Conversation turns read
checklist.description: The agent extracts conversation turns from each session

checklist.name: Tools and git context read
checklist.description: The agent also extracts tools used and git context from each session

checklist.name: Headings adapted
checklist.description: The agent adapts analysis headings where the policy-drafting content does not fit the standard questions

checklist.name: Sessions Reviewed listed first
checklist.description: The report starts with a Sessions Reviewed list covering the 4 sessions

checklist.name: Learnings tied to sessions
checklist.description: Each learning cites the specific session it came from

checklist.name: Output written to the PERIOD file
checklist.description: The report is written to the configured domain insights folder under the PERIOD file name

checklist.name: File path reported
checklist.description: The agent reports the output path to the user
